conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, prioritizing stability. Expect lower potential returns but also substantially reduced drawdown risk.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while maintaining exposure to quality tech. Expect moderate returns with controlled drawdown risk.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month by leaning into leveraged ETFs and concentration. It significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk. Be aware that leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this strategy can lead to substantial losses quickly if stops are not strictly adhered to.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month by prioritizing steady monthly distributions. It significantly reduces leverage and high-beta holdings. While aiming for low drawdown, distributions are variable, and NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
